title: Volume 2 Chapter 3: Howling for You Who Cannot Cry 1
content: Stepping forward, I barely dodged a fist that looked like a solid black iron mass.
A part of my right ear grazed it and, as if in a joke, was blown away.
That's when I realized my body enhancement's intensity had dropped.
In other words── the magic circle was breaking.
When we adventurers say the magic circle is breaking, it's a simple metaphor.
It means that I couldn't construct a magic circle strong enough to withstand the magical power I was pouring into it, or that the body constructing the magic circle was weaker than the circle itself.
There are various reasons, such as not being able to channel magical power effectively into the magic circle or simply not having enough magical power.
In such cases, it's often said that the magic circle has broken when the magic fails to activate or is unintentionally interrupted.
I had thought of it as just a metaphor until now.
But the magic circle can really break.
I could feel the magic circle I had constructed within my body shattering.
I thought that perhaps my master was someone who could understand such things, and that idea suddenly crossed my mind.
At the same time, I realized, wait?
If I just connected this magic circle a bit more, I could maintain body enhancement for at least one more swing, couldn't I?
Suddenly, I felt a heat building deep in my chest.
I could swing one more time.
After all, I'm going to die anyway. If I swing with the intent to die, I can reach him, someone whispered in my heart.
That's right, I'm going to die anyway, someone in my heart agreed.
Ah, yes, I nodded.
I am going to die.
But if I can take him down with me here.
Then this guy, the Great Demon Knight, won't stand before Erika.
I became aware of my face wearing a fierce grin.
...Huh?
Erika?
That's right, it's Erika. It's Erika.
After asking to be with her for a whole year, is this what I get?
Would she think anything of the man who said that dying quickly?
Would she mourn for me?
Ah, but still, I had almost a whole year left, and I could have stood by her side. Ah, what? Am I going to die?
Don't be ridiculous!
"I still have a year left!"
I felt my body, which was completely ready to die with him, suddenly surprised.
No, I can't do that. What was I thinking? To die for her? Am I an idiot?
Leave her alone? Me? Enough with the nonsense. Adventurers are supposed to cling to life.
If I can't live for the woman I love, then I should die cleanly!
Returning to my "sane" self, I hurriedly connected the shattering magic circle, desperately connecting it.
If I keep this up, I will die. Simply die. No matter what I do, I will die.
With the influence of body enhancement, my thoughts rolled around foolishly.
No good, I will die no matter what.
Even if I endure, I will die; even if I deflect the fist, I will die; even if I swing my sword down on his head, I will die.
No, is it going to be a mutual kill in the end? Either way, I'm going to die.
No good, idiot! I'm such an idiot!
The scattered thoughts ultimately chose a foolish option.
I might really be an idiot.
I admit it, I am an idiot.
I would throw everything away just to be with the woman I love, and I would stake my life on it.
I moved the connected body enhancement magic circle to my back, to the clothes that had been enhanced.
In that moment, the magic circle, on the verge of collapse, held firm.
With my last ounce of strength, I slid my sword in front of the deadly fist.
The Great Demon Knight's fist slid along the blade's edge.
I no longer had the strength to deflect it.
I stepped again with my right foot, which I had used to advance.
As my master said, if it's an opponent I've never faced before, I can always deceive them and kill them once.
My body sank forward, slipping to the left side of the Great Demon Knight.
With all my remaining strength, I struck the sword into his side, where his momentum from swinging his fist had left him off balance.
Damn it.
I felt the blade bounce off the thick muscles of his side; the connected magic circle didn't have enough output.
I sensed an almost certain death coming from the deadly line of magical power piercing me.
I refuse to die.
With that single thought, I pulled the sword closer and forced my body up with my stretched-out right leg.
I felt something important in my right leg break.
The blade I pulled in met the Great Demon Knight's fist.
My body was blown sideways.
I didn't die when I was slammed into the ground because the body enhancement did its last job.
"Wow," my body is all intact? "Wow," it's a miracle.
While I struggled to breathe from the impact on my back, I tried to do something about the weakened body enhancement.
Healing could wait; I had to dodge, even if I was broken or torn.
Just wait a moment; I will use all my strength to enhance my body and kill you.
But I knew that wouldn't be enough.
That monster king wouldn't miss such an opening.
Grimacing at the pain coursing through my body, I lifted my head, and what came into view was the Great Demon Knight, who had made a gesture to protect the side I had struck with my sword──.
A visible mass of murderous intent directed at me.
Don't die, this is me dying.
Though I tried my best, reality was cruel, and without the strength to repel the unreasonable, I would be trampled.
The faces of my adventurer comrades from Faltarl flickered in my mind, the ones who always said,
"You're still not there yet.
" My master even treated me like a half-baked adventurer.
In the end, I couldn't become a full-fledged adventurer like them. I was just an ordinary person.
I bit down on my heart and body, which were on the verge of giving up, but my body moved only sluggishly in despair.
Still, I somehow managed to lift my upper body.
The Great Demon Knight's magical power was aiming for my stomach.
When I saw the Great Demon Knight stepping forward, I had a vision of the classroom at the academy.
Between several desks, I burned her profile into my vision as if I were peeking.
To be reminded of Erika's profile at such a moment, I couldn't help but be disappointed in myself.
Even at the brink of death, I felt embarrassed to look directly at her face.
How pathetic.
The weakened body enhancement still hadn't recovered, which meant that the Great Demon Knight's figure had disappeared from my sight.
Now, how do I survive?
If I could manage just one hit, I could still fight.
Think.
Yes, think in reverse; it's no good because I'm trying to endure.
I just need to release the body enhancement from the part of my body where the monster king is aiming his fist.
With a flexible mind.
Using half of my stomach to deflect the punch, good, this will let me survive. And kill.
A calm version of me in my head was holding its head in despair, but I ignored it. I bared my teeth in a grin.
I will survive from now on, and I will laugh and grant Erika's whims.
I want to laugh about trivial things, and I want to eat the skewered meat from the stall that Erika was concerned about the other day together.
Come on, I'll give you half my stomach.
Your payment will be your head, okay?
──And then my ears were burned by flames.

With the intensity of body enhancement lowered, my senses had dulled to a level just slightly more sensitive than a normal person, and I shouldn't have been able to perceive anything happening in a realm beyond human.
Yet, I distinctly heard that voice.
"Just in time!"
I instinctively closed my eyes at the deafening noise and shockwave that erupted before me.
When I opened my eyelids, I found myself in heaven.
Praying that it wasn't the case, when I opened my eyes, I was left questioning whether this was reality.
How much skill, how much talent does it take for a human to do something like this?
As if it were the most natural thing in the world, she stopped the falling mop handle with her foot.
Erika had kicked up her right leg to stop the Great Demon Knight's fist.
With her beautifully extended leg, it was as if her anchored foot was rooted straight into the earth.
She looked like an ancient statue in beauty, but the ground her anchored foot was rooted in vividly told the story of the shock she had absorbed.
I could still hear the sound of the ground cracking.
The Great Demon Knight, baring its fangs in frustration, tried to swing its immobile fist.
In this surreal scene, I couldn't help but murmur the only name I could believe in.
"Erika."
Had my lungs been crushed when I was slammed to the ground?
The sound that came from my throat was a mixture of blood and her name.
But had my lungs been crushed? No wonder I was struggling to breathe.
As if sensing my voice, she slowly turned her gaze toward me.
Terrifyingly, the leg that continued to hold back the Great Demon Knight's fist didn't budge an inch.
I had to secure my breathing, so I concentrated healing magic into my lungs, and my healed lungs quickly went to work.
I instinctively held my breath at the gaze Erika directed at me.
To be honest, I had never seen her so angry before.
Why is Erika so angry?
I had never seen her this angry before, and I was confused about what it meant.
I was confident that no one could match the time I had spent watching Erika.
I was aware that I was saying something a bit creepy, but it was reality, so give up, me.
With her expression of anger, which I had seen only a handful of times, I couldn't remain calm.
Panicking, I tried to move, ignoring the broken ribs and leg bones, and ended up making a pathetic twitching motion.
I wondered if Erika was angry because I was making a fool of myself.
I had to stand up, but my body was in a hurry, and the healing magic couldn't keep up.
No good, I can't stand up.
In that case, I should just use body enhancement to spring up; I raised the intensity of my body enhancement to the fastest level possible, I should have done this earlier.
Seeing my state, Erika's eyebrows shot up at a sharp angle.
Why is she getting even angrier!?
No, is it because I'm twitching pathetically?
Does Erika dislike men who twitch?
I get it; I dislike that kind of man too.
"...Just a moment."
Her icy voice froze me in place.
"Please wait right there."
Erika turned her gaze away from me and faced the Great Demon Knight.
"I'll finish this quickly."
Though I could only see the back of her head, the surging golden magical power was evident.
"Yes."
I could only respond that way.
Because, really, I'm scared, you know?
I honestly doubted whether my response had reached Erika after I said yes.
Not because she was angry, but because she had swung her leg, which had perfectly stopped the Great Demon Knight's fist.
My ears rang from the magical wave that erupted.
Humans can only fight on equal terms with monsters when they can use body enhancement magic.
Thus, being able to defeat a monster that can use magic similar to body enhancement or attack magic alone is a condition to reach Rank 8 in the Faltarl Kingdom.
However, that doesn't mean that one can match a monster with body enhancement in physical abilities.
After all, we are humans; we should use tools.
So, the reason I was dumbfounded by the reality unfolding before me was that I was a common-sense person, and it was proof that I was just an ordinary human.
The Great Demon Knight, who had been desperately trying to swing its right arm, was thrown off balance by a kick to the front.
And──.
The Great Demon Knight's black exterior was said to be comparable to the scales of a powerful dragon or something.
Its head was covered in thick skin like a human knight's helmet.
──And Erika's kick exploded against its face.
A sound like that could never come from a human foot.
That sound vividly echoed in my ears.
Even with the weakened intensity of body enhancement, my eyes kept up with the movement.
The Great Demon Knight's massive body was thrown off balance, and Erika kicked its head, which had fallen to a convenient position, with beautiful form.
I could tell she used wind magic to accelerate her kick at the moment she struck.
Was she enhancing the movement of her body with another magic?
I knew there were skills that resembled that.
But I didn't know anyone who could purely replicate that with magic.
I reflected on myself. I reflected deeply.
To be honest, just a short while ago, I had thought that maybe I was somewhat of a genius for being able to fight the Great Demon Knight head-on.
How embarrassing.
My master had said it too.
He said that as long as humans put in the effort, they could reach Rank 7... or was it that they had to be willing to die?
Having learned at the academy and received teachings from my master, who, despite being a kind person, was truly exceptional in his own right.
Finally, my master said that if it was just sword fighting, I could barely reach Rank 7, so I was just an ordinary person.
I felt ashamed of my arrogance in front of a true genius.
Later, I would apologize to Erika, saying I thought she was a genius, but I had underestimated her.
But still──.
Why is Erika only using kicks to fight?
Even after the Great Demon Knight's face had been kicked, it still groaned while protecting its side.
Erika turned to me, looking like she wanted to say something.
"Was that you?"
For a moment, I didn't understand what she was saying, but then comprehension caught up.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6xtiD56.jpeg
It must have been about why the Great Demon Knight was protecting its side.
Perhaps the damage from my attack had lingered.
Why hadn't I noticed?
No good, with Erika around, my stupidity accelerates.
When I nodded back, Erika murmured.
"Impressive, I see why it was 'quite' easy."
Saying that, Erika unleashed another kick.
The sound of air splitting and an explosion echoed.
The Great Demon Knight, kicked in the head again, used the momentum to regain its stance, spewing drool and a roar of anger as it swung its fist down.
Erika dodged it with minimal movement and aimed a kick at the Great Demon Knight's stomach.
In an instant, three kicks struck the Great Demon Knight's abdomen.
The Great Demon Knight, the king of monsters, writhed in agony.
Stumbling back a step, the Great Demon Knight swayed.
At that moment, Erika glanced over at me.
Huh? What was that look? What does it mean?
Confused by the meaning of Erika's gaze, I almost tilted my head while checking if my previously broken or shattered leg bones had healed.
I thought I heard Erika mutter, "I see, next is the legs."
The Great Demon Knight lunged at Erika, who had taken her gaze away, but strangely... no, of course, it was only natural.
I felt no anxiety whatsoever.
It was only natural for it to turn out this way.
The Great Demon Knight's attack split the air.
Then came the sound of a whip cracking.
...Why a low kick?
The beautifully executed yet unremarkable kick struck the Great Demon Knight's right leg, but it only staggered it.
No, why are you so fixated on kicks?
Perhaps feeling mocked or some other emotion, the Great Demon Knight let out a clear roar of anger.
──But Erika launched a relentless counterattack.
Low kick, low kick, low kick.
Just a series of low kicks.
Maybe I just didn't know, but was there a low kick as a required subject for noble daughters at the academy?
The Great Demon Knight, who had been angered and underestimated by such trivial attacks, clearly showed signs of panic on its face.
No matter how much it swung its fists, it couldn't even graze Erika, so it would naturally be anxious.
Moreover, Erika was elegantly dodging while relentlessly delivering low kicks, making it unbearable for the Great Demon Knight.
I couldn't help but exclaim.
Finally, the Great Demon Knight made a face like "Aaaah" and collapsed to the ground. Its right leg was swollen purple.
I could only stand in shock at the surreal sight of the king of monsters, feared by all, unable to rise due to low kicks.
And Erika quietly looked down at the fallen Great Demon Knight.
She didn't pursue it; she simply looked down quietly.
The Great Demon Knight lifted its face to look at Erika── and then fled.
The Great Demon Knight, a type of King series feared as the king of monsters, turned its back and dragged its feet as it fled.
Erika turned around and smiled.
"Is that all right?"
I could only nod.
I didn't understand the meaning of the question, but I reflexively nodded because she asked.
It had such an overwhelming presence that I couldn't say otherwise.
In an instant, I envisioned myself being scolded by Erika about my grades in the classroom at dusk.
I felt a bit happy about it.
Of course, I was the one feeling that way.
No, no, what is this delusion?
While I was seriously questioning my own delusion, Erika leaped lightly.
In reality, with body enhancement in full effect, her speed was difficult to catch with the eye, and the power behind her every move exceeded human limits.
But to my eyes, Erika appeared light as a feather.
Approaching the fleeing Great Demon Knight with a series of light, graceful steps, she resembled a water bird landing on the surface of the water.

The forest corner, which had suddenly become a sunlit square, sparkled like a shimmering surface of water, and her red hair, colored by the golden magical power rising from her body, looked like beautiful feathers.
So, it appeared almost gentle.
As if to gently accompany the back that had abandoned all pride and fled, Erika's leg overlapped.
The result that emerged was the opposite of the image I had held.
The Great Demon Knight's massive body flew sideways at an incredible speed and crashed into the wall of the crater it had created, sinking into the dust.
I was certain that the Great Demon Knight would never rise again.
To be honest, I had prepared myself for death and feared it. Just a moment ago.
But I truly sympathized with the one who had made me ready for such a resolution.
In other words, standing before an angry Erika as an enemy was something else entirely.
Alright, all you charming men out there.
What do you do when a woman is angry and you don't know why?
Please tell me! I really need to know right now!
"Are you okay?"
Having been told to "just wait," I had been waiting there when Erika knelt beside me and asked.
The look on Erika's face as she looked down at me was genuinely worried and yet gentle, but I couldn't tell if that was the
"correct
" response.
Just a little while ago, she had kicked down a monster, and now she had a face that seemed too gentle for a human.
Charming men! Charming men! Help me! I need advice right now!
With no option to respond with silence to Erika's question, I tried to force an answer out, but my throat wouldn't cooperate.
So, I could only nod in response when Erika's right hand gently rested on my throat.
She pushed my upper body, which she had been gently raising, back down to the ground.
"Your throat is still not well, is it?"
Saying that, Erika activated healing magic.
The warm magical power flowing from her palm was indeed gentle.
She's not angry? Erika's not angry?
Just as I thought that, Erika's brow furrowed deeply.
Damn it, she's definitely angry.
Erika placed her left hand on her forehead to hide the furrow in her brow.
"How reckless have you been...?"
"Well, you see..."
I was slightly surprised that a proper voice came out of my throat.
"I had to be reckless to survive against that opponent."
"There are degrees to these things, you know. You have less intact parts than not; it's a miracle you survived."
"I'm a bit better than average at healing magic."
Though I could only say that about myself.
"Even so... that's..."
Erika's face── was it anxiety? Her brow furrowed for reasons other than anger.
Ah, I see, no, no, that's not it, Erika. That's not it.
"Above all, why didn't you run away?"
After a moment of hesitation that was difficult to notice, Erika asked that.
For some reason, I could clearly understand Erika's anxiety.
I couldn't even tell if she was angry.
But I was absolutely certain of that.
"We are adventurers; we are adventurers now. It is only logical to run from an opponent we cannot defeat."
This time, I hesitated clearly.
"If you didn't run away, it would be my..."
"That's not it, Erika."
I closed my eyes to truly feel the comforting magical power and relaxed.
I hid a wry smile that spilled out from the comfort.
"You might not believe me, but I am serious about being the husband in this farce."
You probably figured it out ahead of time, knowing how smart you are, right?
You think I pushed myself too hard to meet your expectations, don't you?
You probably regret it again, just like always.
When I put expectations on you, you try to meet them and end up collapsing.
Erika has seen that happen many times.
She is aware of that bad habit.
Meanwhile, the foolish me doesn't rush to answer.
"If I stand next to you, if I continue to stand, I can't just run away after that level of attack."
I slowly began to articulate the reason I hadn't run away.
Even though I knew I didn't feel like I could win, I didn't even think about running away.
"Above all, letting something like that pass in front of my wife would make me a failed husband, wouldn't it?"
Well, in the end, I let it pass. It's truly frustrating; next time, I will definitely kill it.
"I haven't exchanged vows, but we are a couple, right? Then I must uphold the vows of a couple."
I opened my eyes slightly to look at Erika's face.
Perhaps my words were unexpected; Erika's eyes widened in surprise, and she looked shocked, as if she were confirming something, her slightly larger monologue.
"To share joy..."
"And to share difficulties."
I picked up Erika's monologue and continued.
It's a wedding vow that even children know.
The difficulties we share while standing by your side seem quite challenging.
I couldn't run away after that level, could I?
I want to indulge in my wife's cute whims.
My joking words made Erika smile wryly.
In this moment, I couldn't honestly say I loved her, and in my heart, I screamed, Come on, me! You can do this!
"Then in the end, isn't it my 'fault'?"
"That's not it."
I gently peeled Erika's hand from my throat and sat up.
My heart raced at the warmth of her body lingering on my throat.
"The reason I didn't run away is that I wanted to, and it was for Erika. It's not Erika's 'fault.'"
